title: Guess the Place · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Guess the Place · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead writes a familiar place and prepares three truthful clues about it. The lead shares the clues one at a time without naming the place. The group identifies the written place. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Guess the Place, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group identifies the written place.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group identifies the written place.
